prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square seamless albedo-only source tile for a low-poly fantasy coastal terrain material
Primary request: Create a repeatable pale coastal limestone gravel and fine shingle ground texture for island shores, harbour edges and exposed banks.
Style/medium: quiet painterly low-poly fantasy ground consistent with Eloria's approved stylized grass/desert assets; medium-scale surface detail.
Composition/framing: flat orthographic square tile with evenly distributed fine-to-small rounded limestone chips and compact gravel; left/right and top/bottom edges must wrap seamlessly with no framing or visual edge treatment; no center feature.
Color palette: pale warm grey, chalky cream and soft subdued green-grey, with small low-contrast darker mineral flecks.
Materials/textures: compact weathered limestone grit and smooth small shingle, gently mottled, lightly worn by shore water; intended world repeat about 4 metres, readable at gameplay camera distance without becoming a field of dots.
Lighting/mood: uniform neutral diffuse albedo only.
Constraints: both-axis seamless repeat; texture only, no water or shoreline geometry; diffuse base colour only.
Avoid: large distinct rocks, centerpiece stones, high contrast white pebbles, noisy dots, shells, seaweed, plants, water, foam, dramatic strata, edge frame, borders, gradients, shadows, highlights, directional lighting, perspective, horizon, text, logos, watermark.
